method.guestEncode: compiled encoder + sink selection/flush + one opaque no-op host import per 500 ops; no GPU calls
method.decodeOnly: protocol/operand decoder into no-op handlers; optimisable lower bound, not general handler cost
method.decode: decode + handle/state/operand validation + CPU WebGPU recording calls
method.direct: same 500 CPU WebGPU recording calls; no decode; both exclude pass creation/end/finish and are not submitted
method.uploads: same 16 MiB current guest-memory range and GPU buffer, alternating lane order; drain queue before each lane; cpuMs ends when writeBuffer returns; completionWaitMs/wallMs include explicit empty submit, browser scheduling and queue completion, not GPU-only timestamp time
method.repeats: CPU metrics average 8 repetitions per sample; raw values are normalised to 500 ops
method.excluded: wasm instantiation, byte-pattern generation, validation readback and pass creation/end/finish
